items.stem: The Onyx Chamber runs 08:00-22:00. Reservations require 15-minute setup before the public start time. Cleanup requires 15 minutes after the public end. Public-facing time is limited to 5 hours maximum. Which reservation is valid?
The Amber Hall operates 10:00-18:00. If a reservation starts before 14:00, it may last up to 3 hours. If it starts at or after 14:00, it may last up to 2 hours. Which reservation is valid?

The Jade Gallery accepts reservations from 08:00 to 20:00. Priority members may book any slot. Standard members may only book slots starting at or after 12:00. Which reservation is valid for a standard member?

The Special Exhibit opens at 13:00. Morning slots (before 13:00) are reserved for members only; afternoon slots require a guide fee of $50. A non-member arrives at 12:30 wanting the earliest possible slot. What applies?

choices.A: Can enter at 12:30 with no fee
choices.C: Must wait until 13:00 with no fee

items.stem: The North Wing opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00. A reservation must end at least 30 minutes before closing. The maximum duration is 4 hours. Which 09:00 reservation is valid?
The Rotunda has consecutive 90-minute slots starting at 09:00. A reservation can span multiple slots if continuous. The last slot must start by 16:30. Which reservation is impossible?
Room A and Room B share a single attendant. A booking in Room A from 09:00-12:00 blocks Room B during that window. Room B opens at 08:00 and closes at 16:00. When can Room B be reserved for 2 hours?

The Ruby Room opens at 09:00. Existing reservations take precedence: a new reservation is rejected if it overlaps any confirmed reservation. Confirmed: 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-16:00. Which new reservation is accepted?
The East Gallery opens at 10:00 and closes at 18:00. Reservations over 3 hours require 24-hour advance notice. A group submits a request at 09:00 today for tomorrow. Which reservation is accepted?
The Sapphire Wing opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00. A reservation must end at least 30 minutes before closing. The maximum duration is 4 hours. Which reservation is valid?
